trust_decision.summary: ProcessSSDPData decides whether the attacker-supplied M-SEARCH MX header value is acceptable before it is used as a divisor for the response delay; at the pinned commit only negative/missing values are rejected or defaulted, so MX: 0 reaches the division.

landing_point.why: Summary names the SSDP M-SEARCH MX header; the only MX parser in the daemon is this block in ProcessSSDPData.

fix_sites.entry_point: SSDP UDP M-SEARCH packet (port 1900) -> ProcessSSDPRequest -> ProcessSSDPData
SSDP UDP M-SEARCH packet, UPNP_STRICT build
SSDP UDP M-SEARCH packet, DELAY_MSEARCH_RESPONSE-only build

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Little room: the strict and delay-only branches are mutually exclusive #ifdef/#elif arms in the same function 10 lines apart; a solver could argue the non-strict DELAY_MSEARCH_RESPONSE arm is not built by default, but configure enables both together under --strict (miniupnpd/configure:1056-1082).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Missing MX in strict mode must still be silently dropped, MX>5 must be clamped to 5 and still answered, and in delay-only builds missing MX defaults to 1; an over-broad fix (e.g. dropping every out-of-range MX) would stop answering legitimate MX: 10 searches.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ssdp:all path computes delay_increment = (mx_value*1000)/15; a variant dividing by mx_value (e.g. per-response spread RAND_MAX/(mx_value*N)) would be a realistic second divisor reached by a different ST value.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The ssdp:all branch already spreads responses over the MX window; a maintainer randomising each step would naturally write a division by mx_value there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: minissdpd answers M-SEARCH on behalf of registered services without any MX-based delay; a planted DELAY-style random()/(… mx) there would be a real second implementation in another daemon/package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same UDA 1.1 'SHOULD wait a random period up to MX' requirement applies to minissdpd's responder; a maintainer porting the miniupnpd delay code would copy the division.

O9_family: numeric: divide-by-zero from unvalidated protocol header value (CWE-369)

O10_build.project_tests: miniupnpd/testminissdp.c feeds a raw SSDP packet from a file/stdin into ProcessSSDPData (testminissdp.c:19-35); needs a config.h with DELAY_MSEARCH_RESPONSE (configure --strict) to reach the sink.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change `mx_value < 0` to `mx_value <= 0` in both #ifdef arms (or guard the two divisions at minissdp.c:1281/1362) - which is essentially the complete fix.

out_of_scope_notes: miniupnpd/upnppinhole.c:742 uses rand()%c in an apparently disabled iptables pinhole helper; unrelated to MX, not pursued.
